entities.summary:
Blas Villate y de la Herra, 2nd Count of Valmaseda was a Spanish general. He was several times governor of Cuba:September 24, 1867 - December 21, 1867 
December 13, 1870 - July 11, 1872
March 8, 1875 - January 18, 1876
